name: sispro-mobile
description: SisPro Mobile — cadastro local de sites com sync (Android/iOS via Capacitor)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
